headline: Knee-high prime-angle dribble — glassy dawn log or skip it.
today: Small SSE at a prime angle but only around 1.5ft, so it's a longboard-only affair. Morning is glass with W wind under 5mph — get it early. Onshore SSW builds through the afternoon and it fizzles.

daysToWatch.note: Some size shows on an ESE swell but 16mph E cross wind runs all day. Junky.
Around 2.4ft on a prime SSE angle with light morning wind, though the period is short. Best clean window of the weekend — log the early tide.
